review_text: Had masala chai and poha at Pink City Chai House before work. Both were fresh, and the bill was clear.
Booked a table at Hawa Mahal Kitchen for 8 pm; we were seated a little late, but the dal baati and service made up for it.
The kachori stayed crisp on delivery and the mirchi vada was packed separately. Proper Jaipur breakfast.
Order from Gulabi Thali arrived 40 minutes late. Paneer was cold and one roti was missing.
Paid on PhonePe at Pink City Chai House; payment went through (demo ref PHONEPE-DEMO-JAI-005) but the counter showed unpaid. Staff asked me to pay again; refund is still pending.
Rang Mahal Stay had a clean room and helpful reception. Parking filled up after 9 pm, so call ahead.
Asked for a GST invoice at Johari Bazaar Home. Invoice came after a second request; the cushion covers were good quality.
कमरा साफ़ था और स्टाफ़ ने जल्दी मदद की। Pink Courtyard Inn में सुबह की चाय भी अच्छी थी।
RaasFit Studio gets too crowded at the 6:30 pm batch. Equipment is fine, but waiting for one treadmill became tiring.
Thali at Hawa Mahal Kitchen was balanced and not overly spicy. Delivery rider found the lane easily.
Cafe at Bapu Bazaar has great chai; music and peak-hour crowding make it hard to sit and work.
The app showed delivered, but my Jaipur order never reached the gate. Support did not answer for half an hour.
Staff at Pink City Chai House sorted a UPI refund politely. The queue was long on Sunday, chai still excellent.
Reserved a family table at Gulabi Thali for 7:30 pm; we waited 35 minutes and the AC was not working.
Bapu Bazaar staff exchanged the kurta size without fuss. They explained the fabric care in Hindi and packed it neatly.
Brunch at Sukhna Spoon Café was lovely—stuffed paratha, curd, and quick service. We'll come back.
Swiggy order from Sector 22 Tandoor arrived 50 minutes late; naan was soggy and raita had leaked.
The room at Sukhna View Residency was tidy. Parking near the entrance was full during check-in, though staff helped with bags.
Google Pay payment at Chandigarh Cycle Studio failed on their screen but was debited (demo ref GPAY-DEMO-CHD-019). No one confirmed the reversal.
सेक्टर 17 चाट हाउस में खाना बहुत अच्छा था और स्टाफ़ विनम्र था। सेवा भी जल्दी मिली।
Asked Sector 17 Grand Stay for a GST invoice at checkout; got a handwritten slip first, then the proper invoice by email.
Booked a family table at Sukhna Spoon for 8 pm; host found us a table in 10 minutes even though it was packed.
A class at Chandigarh Fit Circle was cancelled in the app, but the monthly pass still showed the session used. Support replied next day.
Great woollen shawl selection at Sector 17 Threads. Shopkeeper let me compare sizes and shared a proper GST bill.
Paneer wrap from Sukhna Spoon Café tasted sour; we reported it, but no one followed up.
Tried the takeaway counter on Madhya Marg. Order was ready on time, but no parking near the gate at peak hour.
Requested a UPI refund from Sector 17 Grand Stay after cancelling within the stated window. Three calls, no update yet.
Warm service at Chandigarh Fit Circle; coach explained beginner form patiently. The 7 am batch has good energy.
Google Maps said Sukhna Spoon was open, but shutters were down at 3 pm. Chai was good once we returned in evening.
Food from Sector 17 Tiffin Room arrived in good condition. Could use a little less oil in the chole, but portion was generous.
Breakfast at Sutlej Dhaba was full of flavour; the aloo paratha came hot with fresh curd. Staff were cheerful.
Waited 45 minutes at Punjab Tandoor House even after our reservation. They served another table first.
The room at Sutlej Residency was clean and the desk arranged a late check-in. Lift queue was slow in the morning.
PhonePe payment for a Ludhiana FitWorks annual plan went through twice (demo ref PHONEPE-DEMO-LDH-034). Front desk asked me to contact the bank.
Great service at Model Town Sports & Shoes. They helped find running shoes for wide feet and issued the GST invoice.
Butter chicken from Punjab Tandoor House was tasty, but the takeaway bag leaked in my car. Please seal the curry box better.
Swiggy delivery from Sutlej Dhaba was marked picked up for ages and arrived cold. Customer support gave a generic reply.
Punjab Tandoor House da sarson da saag kaafi badiya si, makki di roti vi fresh si. Service fast rahi.
At Ludhiana FitWorks, the trainer adjusted my plan after a knee niggle. Locker room could be cleaner.
Asked for a GST bill at Model Town Home Store; the billing desk said system down and sent nothing later.
Booked a 6:45 pm table at Punjab Tandoor House; we got seated at 7:10, but the food arrived quickly after that.
Sutlej Residency staff arranged safe late-night takeaway tea when our bus was delayed. Small gesture, appreciated.
Google Pay refund from Ludhiana FitWorks has not come after 8 days (demo ref GPAY-DEMO-LDH-043). I had to follow up twice.
Good stock and quick exchange at Model Town Sports & Shoes. Peak-hour billing line moved slowly but staff kept it organised.
The food order from Punjab Tandoor House never left the restaurant, though the app said delivered. Order support and restaurant both passed the issue around.
